title: User-scoped managed host files cannot traverse existing symlinks outside the account home
claim: User-scoped ensure_host_file, inspect_host_file, and remove_host_file resolve beneath the absolute account home and reject every existing symlink component before operating. Lexical traversal and absolute paths outside the home are also rejected.
rationale: A parent symlink can redirect a path that passes a lexical home-prefix check to an external directory. That could let an agent running with broader host privileges read, overwrite, or remove a file outside the user managed scope.
owner: wunderous/host-agents owns internal/domain/host managed file resolution and its typed capability behavior.

included: existing path components below the account home
excluded: archive extraction and other host file capabilities with their own path contracts

exception: No symlink component is allowed in an existing user-scoped managed path. A future exception requires a superseding decision and evidence that the operation remains confined beneath the account home.

required: lexical absolute and traversal paths outside the home are rejected
existing parent and final symlink components are rejected
ensure, inspect, and remove cannot affect an outside file reached through a parent symlink

revisionBehavior: Recompute whole-file anchors and update the symlink regression test whenever user-scope path resolution or managed-file operation semantics change.
